title: ingest: backfill entry.zen_generation from image.agesa_version when PSPTool returns None
description:
Goal: 

Acceptance criteria:
- 

## Goal

Unlock the ~37 EPYC ROMs currently in the corpus that ingest cleanly (zero
parse_errors) but contribute zero rows to primary_images because PSPTool
returns zen_generation=None for every entry.

## Background

Verified empirically during the v2 reindex: 36 EPYC ROMs (16 SP3 + 16 SP5 +
4 SP6) plus 1 sTRX4 ROM ingested with proper images.socket and
images.board_class set, but PSPTool's combo_dir / tertiary-tag detection
paths don't fire for single-generation server BIOSes, so every entry's
zen_generation column is NULL. The select command groups by
(zen_generation, board_class, type_id) so NULL-gen entries are dropped.

The upstream PSPTool fix is tracked separately (see issue.md in repo root —
proposes a third detection path via PSP_FW_BOOT_LOADER version major.minor).
This issue is the **downstream workaround** that doesn't require waiting for
upstream.

## Fix

In src/psp_etl/ingest.py:ingest_rom, after PSPTool parsing produces a list of
entries, post-process to backfill missing zen_generation:

1. If the image row has agesa_version set (scrapers populate this from BIOS
   release notes / page metadata), call classify_by_agesa(agesa_version) -
   that function already exists and recognizes Naples/Rome/Milan/Genoa/Turin
   AGESA tags via _AGESA_PATTERNS.
2. For each entry whose zen_generation is None, fill from the image-level
   inferred value.
3. Persist the backfilled entries to the DB.

Optionally (extra credit): also infer from PSP_FW_BOOT_LOADER (type=0x01)
version per the upstream-issue analysis - the version major correlates
strongly with generation and works for ROMs without an AGESA tag:
- 0x09/0x0A -> zen1 (Naples), 0x0B/0x0C -> zen2 (Rome),
  0x13 -> zen3 (Milan), 0x29 -> zen4 (Genoa/Siena),
  0x3D -> zen5 (Turin/Bergamo)

## Verification

After this lands, running the full re-ingest pipeline against the existing
corpus (1265 ROMs) should:
- Add ~80-150 new primary_images rows tagged board_class IN
  ('EPYC','Threadripper')
- Boost the total score sum noticeably (current v2: 28776.4)
- show entries from ASUS / Tyan / ASRock-Rack vendors in the per-vendor
  primary_images breakdown (currently only manual + ASRock Rack appear)

## Acceptance criteria

- All 37 currently-orphaned EPYC ROMs (vendor in ASUS/Tyan, plus
  ASRock-Rack sTRX4) contribute at least one primary_images row each
- Existing AM4/AM5 selection unchanged (regression-test with diff against
  the v2 best_files output)
- Tests cover: a manual-vendor image (no agesa) keeps None gracefully, an
  EPYC image with agesa "Genoa 1.0.0.F" gets Zen 4 across all entries

Refs: CL-82, CL-83, CL-85, CL-86, CL-87, CL-88, CL-77 (schema split), see
issue.md in repo root for upstream PSPTool fix proposal.
